correctness.rationale: The gaps of n ordered iid uniform sites form Dirichlet(1,...,1) and admit n+1 independent exponential numerators. Endpoint domination is W<2Z. The Beta probability follows from an exact integral. The conditional transformed density converges by dominated convergence to Gamma(shape 1/2, rate 1). Conditional Chebyshev controls the common denominator relative to the rare-event probability, yielding the erfc law for the actual covering radius; endpoint symmetry proves the fair independent mark. A separate rational inclusion-exclusion calculation agrees for n=1..40, with quadrature and seeded simulation used only as checks.

value.rationale: The worst-point location is an intrinsic coverage-reliability observable: an endpoint maximizer occurs with a sharp square-root rare-event probability, even though the unconditional coverage threshold has a standard Gumbel scaling. The exact conditional erfc law quantitatively describes the exceptional error magnitude and its endpoint mark. This is information about location and conditional reliability not supplied by a routine expected-radius computation.
